definition: `NoAbsoluteTruth T scope`: no content in scope is absolutely true, i.e. the norm with that scope and an unmeetable standard holds for absolute truth. Global when every content is in scope.
note: Unattributed formulation of the owner's example "there is no absolute truth" (#397). Aristotle's "all false" target (ARIST-MET-IV-8-1012B-ALL-FALSE-SELF-FALSIFYING-A) is the special case read with unindexed truth.
